questions.q: Which is the largest planet in our Solar System?
questions.explain: Jupiter is the largest planet with a mass more than twice that of all other planets combined.

questions.q: Who was the first Prime Minister of India?
questions.explain: Jawaharlal Nehru became the first Prime Minister of India on 15 August 1947.

questions.q: What is the chemical formula for water?
questions.explain: Water is composed of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom, hence H2O.

questions.q: Which river is known as the Ganga of the South?
questions.explain: Godavari is often called the Ganga of South India due to its length and significance.

questions.q: What is the national animal of India?
questions.explain: The Royal Bengal Tiger (Panthera tigris) is the national animal of India.

questions.q: In which year did India gain independence?
questions.explain: India gained independence from British rule on 15 August 1947.

questions.q: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explain: Mars appears red due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

questions.q: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explain: Canberra is the capital city of Australia, not Sydney or Melbourne.

questions.q: Who wrote the Indian national anthem?
questions.explain: Jana Gana Mana was written by Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore.

questions.q: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explain: The Pacific Ocean covers about 63 million square miles, making it the largest.

questions.q: Which element has the atomic number 1?
questions.explain: Hydrogen is the lightest element with atomic number 1.

questions.q: What is the currency of Japan?
questions.explain: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is the official currency of Japan.

questions.q: Which is the smallest continent?
questions.explain: Australia is the smallest continent with an area of about 7.7 million sq km.

questions.q: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.explain: An adult human body has 206 bones.

questions.q: What is the hardest natural substance?
questions.explain: Diamond is the hardest known natural substance with a rating of 10 on Mohs scale.

questions.q: Which vitamin is produced when exposed to sunlight?
questions.explain: Vitamin D is synthesized in the skin when exposed to ultraviolet B radiation from sunlight.

questions.q: What is the speed of light approximately?
questions.explain: Light travels at approximately 3,00,000 km/s (3 x 10^8 m/s) in vacuum.

questions.q: Which country has the most population?
questions.explain: India overtook China as the world's most populous country in 2023.

questions.q: What is the full form of CPU?
questions.explain: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit, the brain of a computer.

questions.q: Who invented the telephone?
questions.explain: Alexander Graham Bell is credited with inventing the first practical telephone in 1876.
